103
NO-RHILD ALTEPNATE
Advantages
No lands converted to public ownership and therefore no relocation of homes or businesses.
Least disruptive to new and existing development.
Disadvantages 
Not consistent with SFWPP Land Use and Transportation Plan, Milwaukee County Jurisdictional Highway Plan, Milwaukee Area Transit Plan, and Air Terminal Master Plan.
In conflict with national gnals of providing direct access between two types of interstate carriers.
Would do nothing to relieve congestion and accident potential on arterial street system.
Would do nothing to increase the airport accessibility nor meet the projected traffic demands.
Mould require traffic control improvements to relieve localized traffic concestion.
Highest potential for air and noise pollution due to stop and go driving.
Pequires expenditures for maintenance and safety improvements of local streets.
BUILD ALTEPNATE
(Recommended Forridor No. 5)
Advantages
Consistent with SEWPPC Land lise and Transportation Plan, Milwaukee County Jurisdictional Plan, Milwaukee Area Transit Plan and Pegional Airport System Plan.
Meets national doals by providing direct access between two types of interstate carriers.
Compatible with General Mitchell Field's Air Terminal expansion program and air cargo area planning.
Serves projected traffic demands for air transportation service.
Compatible with City of Milwaukee Land Bank.
Will divert airport oriented traffic from the conqested arterial street system.
Provides bus-modified rapid transit entirely over a controlled access freeway system.
Consistent with FHWA established criteria for interchange access geometrics.
Alimment and clearance meets with FAA approval.
Least potential for air * noise pollution.
<u> Nisadvantages</u>
Would be a new transportation corridor; private land would be converted to public ownership.
Peouires relocation of Grande Avenue east of 6th Street. Would displace 34 people in 9 housing units and 3 commercial units.
Would come close to Hamlin-Garland School.
Mould be in embankment section for its entire length.
